text: 记者今天了解到，市场监管总局（国家认监委）与联合国工业发展组织（UNIDO）联合指导实施的“提质护航·丝路共信”食品行业检验检测能力建设与提升培训计划在北京收官。该培训计划旨在深入践行共建“一带一路”倡议，推进食品安全国际协同治理。（新华社）
text_en: The reporter learned today that the training program 'Quality Enhancement and Protection, Silk Road Mutual Trust' for food industry inspection and testing capacity building and improvement, jointly guided and implemented by the State Administration for Market Regulation (CNCA) and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO), concluded in Beijing. The program aims to deeply practice the Belt and Road Initiative and promote international collaborative governance of food safety. (Xinhua News Agency)
